name: General Meeting
description: Flexible notes for a meeting that does not need a specialized format.

sections.title: Purpose and Attendees
sections.instruction: State the purpose and list participants mentioned in the transcript.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the discussion and most important context in concise language.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List decisions that were explicitly made. Say none if no decision was made.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List each commitment with owner and due date when stated. Do not invent either.

sections.title: Open Questions and Risks
sections.instruction: List unresolved questions, risks, issues, or dependencies.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List agreed next steps and follow-up meetings.
